import sys

D = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
out = []
for line in sys.stdin:
    p = line.split()
    if len(p) < 3:
        continue
    n = int(p[0], int(p[1]))
    b = int(p[2])
    if n == 0:
        out.append("0")
        continue
    s = []
    while n:
        n, r = divmod(n, b)
        s.append(D[r])
    out.append("".join(reversed(s)))
print("\n".join(out))
